data.body:
Split implemented in worktree flamingo-reflock-split.

Shape: tail cluster moved to src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock_push.py (147 LOC) via lazy_load('rebar_reconciler_ref_lock_push', '_ref_lock_push.py'). _ref_lock.py: 800 -> 730 LOC. Lines 1-708 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-split file; only the tail is replaced by four wrapper/binding lines plus the three 4/5-arg wrappers. The call sites at :393, :422, :476 are unchanged.

Late binding: every child entry point takes the calling module as an explicit 'core' first argument and reads core._git / core._REMOTE_TIMEOUT_SECS / core.logger at CALL time. No import cycle; the child imports nothing from the package.

Mutation-checked the new tests rather than trusting them:
- Mutant (child re-loads _ref_lock under its own loader key — the exact trap the ticket recorded): 13 failures, including all three new patch-point params, the new logger test, and the ticket's recorded symptoms test_transport_failures_stay_fail_closed[auth failed]/[dns failure] and test_cas_mismatch_logs_the_stderr_that_justified_it. Reproduces the previous attempt's failure signature exactly.
- Mutant (logger re-homed onto the child module): the new logger test fails on record.name == 'rebar_reconciler_ref_lock_push'.

Behaviour-identical note: the two bug-ebee markers that were appended with '+=' are now inline members of the NON_CAS_REJECT_MARKERS tuple literal. Same six values, same order, no semantic change — the '+=' only existed to avoid adding a line under the old cap.

Gates so far: 2409 reconciler tests pass; targeted classification + module-size contract pass (23); make lint clean; make typecheck clean (510 files). Full unit suite + complexity ratchet running.
